svg.title: Employee workspace
svg.desc: Five desktop screens: choose a task, clarify its input, monitor progress, request a safe stop, and review the acknowledged stop.

g.text: Choose a task to start working on this device.
Turn meeting notes into a short summary and a list of next steps.
Two documents match “meeting notes.” Choose one before the task starts.
Creating a summary from your meeting notes.
Queued steps were blocked as soon as you clicked Stop task.
Already in progress when you stopped
Waiting for the task to acknowledge
The task has stopped. No queued steps were started.
